description: For an admissible definition package over \(T\), every nonempty \(T\)-model has exactly one interpretation of all the new function and relation symbols satisfying the actual defining axioms. Uniqueness is equality of added structures on the fixed old domain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage.unique_expansion.{u, v, u', v', w}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage L K) (T : L.Theory)
  (hd : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.Admissible d T) [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T] :
  ∃! S, d.IsDefinedExpansion M S
